DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection string — auto-wired from the Postgres companion service. Do not edit.

RUN_MIGRATIONS.description: Run database migrations on startup. Set to 1 for first deploy.

CREATE_ADMIN.description: Create admin user on first run. Set to 1 for first deploy.

ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Admin username for the Miniflux web UI.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Admin password — MUST be at least 12 characters. Change immediately after first login.

BASE_URL.description: Public URL of your Miniflux instance. Used for feed discovery and redirects.

POLLING_FREQUENCY.description: How often (in minutes) Miniflux fetches feeds. Default: 60 minutes.

BATCH_SIZE.description: Number of feeds to fetch in one batch. Default: 100.

MINIFLUX_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Optional: webhook URL for new entries (e.g., Marketing Bot Lite endpoint). Leave empty to disable.
